comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: Visually, 8/10: the 5-minute SAND-USD chart, signal monitor, and P&L panels make the agent’s state unusually easy to scan. For research credibility, I’d add a drill-down behind the 2.03 profit factor and 83 paper trades showing decision time, quoted bid/ask, simulated fill, fees, and model rationale. The displayed $273.50 fees+slippage is promising, but without that ledger it is hard to tell whether the 43.4% win rate and +$1,236.22 survive realistic execution.
